resources.string: Account & sync
Account & sync
What goes to the cloud

Tasks, projects, events, birthdays, remind-me items and reminder settings (and habits later) are copied to your private Supabase project. Notes, journal, body data, photos, voice notes and the reminder history never leave this phone.
Signing in is optional. Everything works without it.
